summary.intent: Execute Phase 23 (rust-sdk-extraction) which extracts the CipherBox Tauri desktop app's core logic into a Cargo workspace with separate crates: cipherbox-crypto, cipherbox-core, cipherbox-api-client, cipherbox-fuse, and cipherbox-sdk.
summary.outcome: Waves 1-3 completed successfully across 5 plans (23-01 through 23-05). Wave 4 (plans 23-06 and 23-07) was spawned but the transcript ends before confirmation of completion.

repo: Project uses a GSD (get-shit-done) workflow system with wave-based parallel plan execution via subagents
The Tauri desktop app had all crypto, domain types, HTTP client, FUSE filesystem, and SDK orchestration colocated before this phase
Rust crates live under crates/ directory: crates/crypto/, crates/core/, crates/fuse/, crates/sdk/
162 desktop tests existed pre-extraction and continued passing after cipherbox-core extraction
Cross-language parity testing between Rust and TypeScript is enforced via shared JSON test vector files
cipherbox-sdk uses zeroize for secure key material zeroing in KeyState

code.finding: Contains AES-GCM, AES-CTR, ECIES, Ed25519, HKDF, and IPNS name derivation primitives
Contains FolderMetadata, FileMetadata, RecycleBinMetadata, DeviceRegistry, vault blob v2, IPNS records, and decrypt_metadata_from_ipfs_public bridge function
Contains InodeTable, MetadataCache, ContentCache, FileHandle; platform code behind feature flags (macOS SMB backend, Linux FUSE, Windows)
Contains SyncDaemon (IPNS polling loop), WriteQueue (offline write queue), KeyState (with zeroize), device registry operations, CipherBoxSdkClient

workflow: GSD subagents can be interrupted mid-execution by usage limits, leaving uncommitted partial work in the working tree
Re-spawning agents after a usage limit interruption is safe — agents detect existing partial state and complete the work
The GSD pre-wave dependency check (verify key-links) is a no-op when plans don't declare key-links; not an error
Spot-checking requires: SUMMARY.md exists, git commits present matching phase-plan pattern, no Self-Check: FAILED marker, and key files exist on disk

friction: Usage limit hit mid-Wave 3 while both 23-04 and 23-05 agents were running, interrupting execution before either agent could commit or create SUMMARY.md
Wave 3 had to be fully retried after the usage limit interruption — no partial commit recovery, both agents re-ran from scratch
